about_the_game:
The battlefield shifts in silence, reshaping itself with every encounter.
Tank Rogue is a tank action roguelike, where you command a lone war machine through a cold, abstract world built from simple geometric forms.

Destroy enemies, collect items, and upgrade your tank — but the battlefield will not go easy on you.
Unique enemies, environmental gimmicks, and unexpected happening events constantly alter the flow of combat.

Each run brings new combinations of upgrades and hazards.
With every survival, your tank grows stronger, and the battlefield grows more complex.
In this world without order, evolution is the only way forward.

Features

  • Roguelike progression: Each stage layout, enemy placement, and item drop changes every run.

  • Tank upgrades: Gather various power-ups and create your own custom war machine.

  • Unique enemies and gimmicks: Simple forms, but complex behaviors.

  • Happening events: Sudden, unpredictable events that test your judgment.

  • Abstract atmosphere: A minimalist world built from silence, tension, and geometry.
